Task.Name: [1.1] Initiation & charter
Task.Notes: Business case review, charter, stakeholder identification; ends at M1.

Task.Name: [M1] Charter approved
Task.Notes: Milestone M1

Task.Name: [1.2] Planning & baselines
Task.Notes: WBS, ProjectLibre schedule, cost baseline, risk register, comms plan, RACI.

Task.Name: [1.3] Monitoring, control & CCB
Task.Notes: Level-of-effort task from end of planning to end of hypercare.

Task.Name: [1.4] Closure
Task.Notes: Admin closure, contract closure, archive, benefits handover; ends at M7.

Task.Name: [M7] Project closed
Task.Notes: Milestone M7

Task.Name: [2.1] Current-state portal audit
Task.Notes: Inventory of the four portals, features, data stores, pain points and early data profiling (R01).

Task.Name: [2.2] Requirements workshops
Task.Notes: Workshops with students, SRC, faculties, Registrar and Service Desk.

Task.Name: [2.3] Solution & SSO architecture
Task.Notes: Target architecture, SSO/MFA design on the existing identity platform (R12), integration patterns.

Task.Name: [2.4] Privacy Impact Assessment
Task.Notes: APP-based PIA covering migration, masking, access logging and retention (R03).

Task.Name: [2.5] UX & accessibility prototype
Task.Notes: Tested with students incl. Accessibility Services; WCAG 2.1 AA patterns (R08).

Task.Name: [M2] Design sign-off
Task.Notes: Milestone M2

Task.Name: [3.1] Sprint 1 SSO & dashboard
Task.Notes: Two-week sprint; SSO proof of concept retires R02/R12 uncertainty.

Task.Name: [3.2] Sprint 2 Enrolment & timetable
Task.Notes: Two-week sprint; enrolment forms, timetable view.

Task.Name: [3.3] Sprint 3 Fees & payments
Task.Notes: Two-week sprint; invoices, payment gateway hand-off, Finance integration.

Task.Name: [3.4] Sprint 4 Services & helpdesk
Task.Notes: Two-week sprint; service requests, knowledge base, chatbot hand-off.

Task.Name: [3.5] Integration APIs (SIS, LMS, Finance)
Task.Notes: SIS, LMS and Finance APIs used by the portal and by trial migration 2 reconciliation.

Task.Name: [3.6] Content & notifications configuration
Task.Notes: Portal content, FAQs and email notification templates (push notifications excluded — CR-01).

Task.Name: [M3] Build complete
Task.Notes: Milestone M3

Task.Name: [4.1] Data mapping & cleansing
Task.Notes: Mapping of four portal data stores to the target model; de-duplication rules (R01).

Task.Name: [4.2] Migration scripts & trial migration 1
Task.Notes: Scripts built and first full trial run on masked data; ISS-01 raised here.

Task.Name: [4.3] Trial migration 2 & reconciliation
Task.Notes: Second trial using the integration APIs; Registrar signs reconciliation; ends at M4.

Task.Name: [M4] Trial migration passed
Task.Notes: Milestone M4

Task.Name: [4.4] Final migration
Task.Notes: Final production migration in the cutover window.

Task.Name: [5.1] System integration testing
Task.Notes: End-to-end tests across portal, SIS, LMS, Finance and migrated data.

Task.Name: [5.2] Security/penetration testing
Task.Notes: External pen-test engagement ($25k fixed) + remediation verification.

Task.Name: [5.3] WCAG 2.1 AA audit
Task.Notes: Finishes 5 days after Sprint 4 (FF+5d link).

Task.Name: [5.4] Load testing (enrolment peak)
Task.Notes: Starts 5 days after SIT starts (SS+5d link).

Task.Name: [5.5] User acceptance testing
Task.Notes: Students, Registrar and faculty staff execute UAT scripts; ends at M5.

Task.Name: [5.6] Regression & defect remediation
Task.Notes: Runs alongside UAT (SS+5d).

Task.Name: [M5] UAT sign-off
Task.Notes: Milestone M5

Task.Name: [6.1] Training & change comms
Task.Notes: Student guides, staff/Service Desk training, go-live comms ($8k materials).

Task.Name: [6.2] Faculty pilot
Task.Notes: Pilot with two faculties' summer-session students and staff.

Task.Name: [6.3] Go-live cutover
Task.Notes: Cutover runbook, production licences activated ($180k); ends at M6.

Task.Name: [M6] Go-live
Task.Notes: Milestone M6

Task.Name: [6.4] Hypercare
Task.Notes: Four weeks of heightened support, daily stand-ups with the Service Desk.

Task.Name: [6.5] Legacy portal decommissioning
Task.Notes: Retire three legacy portals and archive data per retention schedule.
